native.pn_wire_profile: Actual reviewed PNIO2.4 wire schema or another independently registered edition.
native.pn_clock_profile: Actual controller clock policy; manufacturer preset must not become universal.
native.pn_implementation: Actual firmware/stack with its own supported services.
native.pn_phy: Actual conventional100Mbps PHY versus separately sourced physical realization.
native.pn_duplex: Actual point-to-point full duplex, no CAN arbitration.
native.pn_conformance: Actual independently certified functionality class; class D requires own TSN registration.
native.pn_role: Actual IO entity role, independent of industry template.
native.pn_rt_class: Actual cyclic IOCR transport class, not a universal runtime implementation.
native.pn_startup: Actual IOCR startup mode; advanced startup excludes RTC1.
native.pn_service: Actual cyclic IO versus acyclic record/alarm/DCP/LLDP service.
native.pn_state: Actual configured AR/application state; valid Ethernet link alone is not running IO.
native.pn_offset_kind: Actual best-effort UInt32 sentinel versus scheduled nanosecond offset.
native.pn_dcp_service: Actual DCP link-layer commissioning service, not cyclic output data.
native.pn_device_source: Actual firmware/GSDML module/submodule/IOCR lengths and minimum device interval.
native.pn_physical_source: Actual PHY/cable/ports/link rates/full duplex and bridge behavior.
native.pn_schedule_source: Actual per-port competing load/reserved phases/clock synchronization/topology and watchdog.
native.pn_mapping_source: Actual API/slot/subslot/AR ownership and application encoded bytes/status map.
native.pn_address_source: Actual unique station name/MAC and commissioning/IP configuration evidence.
native.pn_registered_source: Actual alternate edition/device/physical/clock/TSN profile source and limitations.
native.pn_station_name: Actual configured PNIO ASCII station name; empty is commissioning only, labels1..63,total<=240.
native.pn_controller_id: Actual owning IO controller identity, not arbitrary allocation.
native.pn_sync_domain: Actual IRT synchronization domain and master, not arbitrary default.
native.pn_irt_source: Actual IRT hardware/topology/phase/sync plan and supported fastest cycle.
native.pn_optional_source: Actual DFP/MRP/MRPD/fast-cycle/shared-device capability and selected configuration.
native.pn_ethertype: Actual L2 PN0x8892 or UDP IPv4 EtherType0x0800.
native.pn_vlan_id: Reviewed IOCR priority tag VID0; generic VLAN1 must not leak into native wire schema.
native.pn_frame_id: Actual16-bit FrameID service/type/class range; output range not inferred from input checker.
native.pn_api_count: Actual configured application process identifiers in IOCR.
native.pn_api_id: Actual32-bit application process identifier;0 is a legitimate API.
native.pn_slot: Actual16-bit module slot, not a physical port index.
native.pn_csdu_bytes: Actual cyclic service data unit includes IO data,IOPS,IOCS and padding; excludes FrameID/APDU.
native.pn_io_data_bytes: Actual aggregate cyclic data encoded bytes, not whole application message size.
native.pn_iops_bytes: Actual provider-status bytes in mapped CSDU.
native.pn_iocs_bytes: Actual consumer-status bytes in mapped CSDU.
native.pn_padding_bytes: Actual cyclic CSDU padding distinct useful data.
native.pn_buffer_bytes: Actual NIC buffer; tagged L2=24+CSDU without FCS; UDP needs own registered overhead.
native.pn_mac_bytes: Actual full MAC frame inclFCS; tagged L2=28+CSDU; preamble/IFG separate.
native.pn_mac_bits: Actual MAC bytes times8, not CAN bit stuffing or UART11bit; UDP overhead separate.
native.pn_send_clock_factor: Actual basic send clock in31.25us units; supported sets depend on source/device.
native.pn_reduction_ratio: Actual update interval/send-clock ratio; UDP wire bound differs native L2.
native.pn_min_device_interval: Actual GSDML MinDeviceInterval in31.25us units, not invented fastest1.
native.pn_data_hold_factor: Actual number of update intervals before data-hold expiration, protocol max7680.
native.pn_frame_send_offset_ns: Actual UInt32 scheduled offset or FFFFFFFF best-effort sentinel; not an application latency.
native.pn_cycle_counter: Actual APDU16-bit31.25us background counter, not packet number.
native.pn_previous_counter: Actual preceding counter for selected normalization/increment formula.
native.pn_next_counter: Actual normalized next counter modulo65536, distinct monitor deadline.
native.pn_data_status: Actual APDU DataStatus octet; bits/acceptance depend on actual consumer.
native.pn_transfer_status: Actual APDU transfer status; selected public PPM emits0.
native.pn_iops: Actual selected public-stack IOXS BAD0/GOOD128, not arbitrary PA quality range.
native.pn_iocs: Actual selected public-stack consumer IOXS BAD0/GOOD128.
native.pn_send_clock_us: Actual basic clock=factor*31.25us, not device application update period.
native.pn_update_us: Actual cyclic interval=send clock*reduction ratio; device and source bounds apply.
native.pn_data_hold_us: Actual communication supervision interval=update*data hold factor, not functional deadline.
native.pn_red_phase_us: Actual reserved IRT phase duration, not generic reserved bandwidth percentage.
native.pn_open_phase_us: Actual remaining RT/IP phase of IRT cycle.
native.pn_serialization_us: Actual full MAC frame serialization only; competing traffic/sync/queues/IFG separate.
native.pn_freshness_us: Actual application functional freshness limit, not borrowed CAN500ms watchdog.
native.pn_record_timeout_ms: Actual device/stack acyclic RPC timeout, not cyclic data hold.
native.pn_alarm_timeout_ms: Actual selected alarm relationship supervision, distinct cyclic update.
native.pn_frame_valid: Actual address/type/length/APDU/FCS checks passed; source-filled fields do not prove reception.
native.pn_mapping_valid: Actual GSDML/modules/status layout and AR ownership verified.
native.pn_data_accepted: Actual functional consumer acceptance, not link-up or watchdog settings.
native.pn_lldp_local_only: Actual LLDP link-local nonforwarding policy on bridges.
native.pn_irt_hardware: Actual IRT-capable devices and switches, not inferred from RTC3 enum.
native.pn_topology_verified: Actual per-port IRT topology and planned timing verified.
native.pn_fast_cycle_capable: Actual optional31.25us fast-cycle support, not every CCCdevice.
native.pn_dfp_enabled: Actual optional dynamic frame packing, not automatically enabled.
native.pn_shared_device: Actual submodule-specific ownership by different ARs/controllers.
native.bitrate: ConventionalPI100Mbps baseline proposal, actual explicit PHY and optionalregisteredotherlink. Not CAN rate or universal RT/IRTtimingproof.
native.payload_bytes: Whole application bytes distinct native CSDU1440 IOdata+IOPS+IOCS+padding and taggedL2NIC24/fullMAC28byteoverhead. No arbitrary8byte/application1440limit.
